5340.title: Embedded composer project fallback
5340.rootCauseOneLine: Plugin project state starts at null when unseeded; fresh-list reconciliation also maps unknown explicit project ids to personal before request assembly.
5340.proposedFix: Decide the omitted-seed project policy, preserve explicit personal choice and local edits, and block unresolved explicit project seeds rather than silently substituting personal.
5340.caveats: Request-boundary reproduction only; loading/replayed unknown projects already have protection. No automated fix because project-defaulting semantics require a product decision. Regression patch and test are embedded in the report.
